verses.1: In the year 17 of King Belashzar of Babylon, Daniel had a dream. In his dream, he saw visions that came from God. These visions were written down by Daniel.
verses.2: Daniel replied, “Look, it will happen in vision with Lelijya. And four spirits of Shmaya will come to the sea.”
verses.3: And four generations of Rabbarban were removed from Yamama Shanyan. That’s what happened.
verses.4: She was like a lion, with strong arms and legs. Her eyes were filled with strength. She could carry things on her shoulders and feet, just like a human being. And in her heart, she loved people deeply.
verses.5: And they said to her, “Live after me. I will give you a gift for your efforts. There are three things that must be done in this matter. And we said to her, ‘Come, I will eat with you.’”
verses.6: At the site of Danah, I saw that there were four wings on its back, and four heads for its life. And it will be ruled by Him who deserves to rule over it.
verses.7: At the site of Dena, I saw what Lileyya had seen. Her life was filled with many hardships and dangers. She threatened me, and I was terrified. There were also those who tried to harm her. She changed from all those who came before her. Her horns numbered twelve.
verses.8: They try to become like the two rays. But one of those rays is removed from them. And three of the four rays are also removed from their original positions. They act like people who have eyes in those rays. And someone says, “Rabban.”
verses.9: He saw that until the time of Karsavan Remi and the younger days, his heart would be filled with sorrow. His hair and eyebrows were like those of a sick man. His body was covered with wounds. His eyes were like those of a sick person.
verses.10: The river Di-Nour flows from its source, covering a distance of thousands of miles. Many people come from that place to live there. They establish laws and regulations there.
verses.11: He saw that it was from a distant place, from a place far away. It was said that it could be seen until the time when the heavens were torn apart and the earth was destroyed. Then it would be given to those who deserve it.
verses.12: And the rest of his descendants ruled over them, and they lived in peace for many years.
verses.13: I saw in my visions of Leliyah. I walked with the clouds of Shemayah. From ancient times to now, you have been king. And before that, there was the sacrifice.
verses.14: And let him have his kingdom, and let it be precious and great. Let him rule over all people and nations. Let his kingdom last forever; let it never be destroyed or lost.
verses.15: The spirit of my soul is in a state of chaos and confusion; my eyes are filled with fear.
verses.16: I will bring it from Kamaia, and I will place it above every altar. Then he said to me, “Let me know.”
verses.17: There are eleven living beings, each of whom is the king of four kings. They arose from the earth.
verses.18: May they receive the kingdom of heaven as a gift from God. May they be rulers over the world forever and ever.
verses.19: Adayin is used to describe four kinds of creatures in the world. Among them, one kind is related to fire; another kind is related to snakes. The rest are those that eat meat.
verses.20: And on its horns, there were twelve branches at the beginning, and then one branch fell off from its top. Its horns became flat. We look at it, and someone says, “It’s magnificent.” It’s more beautiful than all its companions.
verses.21: He saw that the ears were also used for worshiping idols, along with other sacred objects.
verses.22: Until your time is young, and the law will be honored by those who are sacred. At that time, may the kingdom of God be preserved for those who are holy.
verses.23: So, He said: “The fourth king will reign over all kingdoms. He will eat everything that is on earth. He will make everything perfect and strong.”
verses.24: And in Karniya, there were twelve kings who ruled. After them, another king would rise to power. He would be more powerful than his predecessors. And then there would be three more kings who would also rule.
verses.25: And from the side of Ilah, it will speak; and to the priests of Elionin, it will bring light and knowledge. It will renew their time and religion, and they will be strengthened by its power, until the end of time.
verses.26: And her reign will last forever, and she will rule over all things until the end.
verses.27: And her kingdom and all her rulers will be subject to her rule. All those who rule under her will serve her as gods. Her kingdom will be great and powerful, and all her rulers will bow down before her.
verses.28: Until now, all these things have been hidden from me. I am in a state of confusion and turmoil. My heart is also filled with sorrow. And in my heart, there’s a sense of despair.
